findings.passage: It has become clear that states must fight this battle for themselves, and Georgia is now joining that effort by creating its own Voting Rights Act to ensure these foundational liberties are protected. This bill would establish statewide safeguards against voter suppression and dilution by creating legal guardrails such as preclearance, transparency and language access.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name on the Georgia Senate press site about his state voting rights bill SB 536. It does not mention voter ID or citizenship proof; saved as a related voting-rules statement.

Introduced SB 536, the Henry McNeal Turner Voting Rights Act. It would create a Georgia Voting Rights Commission and a voting and elections database and institute, and set up state-level safeguards. The release (dated 2026-02-24) says he introduced it the week before; the bill sits in the Senate Ethics Committee. Not specific to ID or citizenship rules.
